purpose: Outbound group sends and the own-send lifecycle: the canonical rumor builder + single group.send (sendGroupRumor), per-group serialisation of commit ops with synced() and commit-pending retry (groupOpQueue), and the optimistic own-row tracker that confirms by rumor.id from the history sink echo and fails a row on the four D6 triggers without ever downgrading a confirmed row or resending (ownRowTracker).

public_api.name: buildGroupRumor
public_api.signature: (ownPubkey: string, kind: number, content: string, tags: readonly (readonly string[])[], createdAt: number) => Rumor
public_api.description: Pure canonical unsigned rumor; id = nostr-tools getEventHash; validates pubkey hex, kind range, content string, tags string[][]; throws TypeError.

public_api.name: createGroupRumorSender
public_api.signature: (options: { ownPubkey: string; tracker: OwnRowTracker; nowSeconds?: () => number }) => { prepare(group: SendableGroup, kind: number, content: string, tags: string[][]): PreparedGroupRumor; sendGroupRumor(group: SendableGroup, kind: number, content: string, tags: string[][]): Promise<{ id: string; result: unknown }>; retry(group: SendableGroup, rumorId: string): Promise<{ id: string; result: unknown }>; forgetGroup(groupId: string): void }
public_api.description: Seam SendGroupRumor (consumed by S18). prepare() builds the rumor (pubkey = own account) and registers the optimistic row with the REQUIRED tracker; send() calls group.send({type:'application', rumor}) exactly once (idempotent on repeat) and feeds resolve/reject into the tracker; no automatic retry or resend. retry(group, rumorId) re-sends the IDENTICAL stored rumor of a failed row. Each dispatch captures the row's attempt generation (tracker.attemptOf, bumped by tracker.retry): results (resolve, reject, intent binding, the detached synced() waiter) of an older attempt are ignored. SendableGroup.pendingIntents is required (the library always provides it); a group without it warns once and trigger (b) is inert. Same-second id bump guards tracked rows only (residual: a pruned/forgotten row can collide).

public_api.name: createOwnRowTracker
public_api.signature: (options: { ports: { setStatus(groupId, rumorId, status: 'sending'|'confirmed'|'failed'): void; forget?(groupId, rumorId): void }; timeoutMs?: number; maxConfirmedRetained?: number; maxFailedRetained?: number }) => OwnRowTracker
public_api.description: Own-row state machine. register (signal defaults to false)/attemptOf/bindIntent/retry/sendResolved/sendRejected (the last three take an optional attempt generation) from the sender; onOwnEcho(groupId, rumorId, eventId?) and onOwnWithdrawn(groupId, rumorId, eventId?) are the chat handler's required ports; onIntentFailed({groupId}) / onGroupBranchSwitched({groupId}) are the client lifecycle listeners; statusOf, pendingSignals(groupId), forget, dispose. Triggers (a)-(d) act only on unconfirmed rows; only an explicit sink withdraw downgrades a confirmed row; a later echo flips failed to confirmed. No resend port exists.

public_api.name: createGroupOpQueue
public_api.signature: (options?: { maxCommitPendingRetries?: number; commitPendingBackoffMs?: readonly number[]; syncTimeoutMs?: number }) => GroupOpQueue
public_api.description: Seam GroupOpQueue (consumed by S8, S11, S13, S14). run(groupId, op) serialises per group; runCommit(group, op, { signal?, syncTimeoutMs?, skipSync? })/invite/removeMember/setAdmins/rename/leave await group.synced() first (BOUNDED by syncTimeoutMs, default 30 s, and abortable; a wait lost before op() starts rejects GroupOpError not-synced/aborted and the op never runs) and retry a commit-pending rejection by details.reason: own pending commit / selfremove-election-wait / staged-adds-commit-unconfirmed after an ingest([]) barrier (bounded by syncTimeoutMs, abortable, a throwing ingest is logged) plus backoff, awaiting-sync after a bounded synced(), proposal-deferred and unknown reasons surfaced at once (max 3 retries). Never calls the client from a library frame: callers inside a frame schedule through the ClientJobQueue.

public_api.name: pendingOwnSendsStatusPort (in app/src/lib/pendingOwnSends.ts)
public_api.description: Re-points the tracker's status port at the module-scope pending own sends: setStatus(groupId, rumorId, 'sending'|'confirmed'|'failed') keeps a per-row status; failed KEEPS the pending entry and the status (failed/retry), confirmed settles the pending send as persisted (kept visible as confirmed while an own edit/delete is in flight); forget(groupId, rumorId) (tracker forgot the row: discard, group left, eviction beyond maxFailedRetained) drops the status AND the pending entry (settled not persisted) and announces 'forgotten'; unknown rows are a no-op.

owned_data: in-memory own-row status per (groupId, rumorId) and the confirmation timers
dependencies_allowed: app/src/lib/marmot/history (GroupHistoryHandlers seam, consumed through the handler ports wired by S18)
app/src/lib/marmot/client (ClientJobQueue seam: callers schedule ops from library frames with handle.enqueue)
dependencies_forbidden: app/src/lib/marmot/chatPersistence and the stores (the tracker reports status through an injected port only)
external_ports: OwnRowStatusPort.setStatus (required; no silent default), OwnRowStatusPort.forget (optional, wired by pendingOwnSendsStatusPort)
CommitOpGroup.synced (+ optional ingest([]) barrier) + the five commit ops
events_consumed: history sink own echo (handler port onOwnEcho) and own withdraw (handler port onOwnWithdrawn)

seams.name: ClientJobQueue (consumed by callers of GroupOpQueue inside library frames)
